title: Documents
description: The section's contracts, meeting minutes and permit applications, and the rental contracts this app draws itself.
emptyDescription: Upload a document you already have, or draw a new rental contract.
fileCount: {count, plural, =0 {No file} one {1 file} other {# files}}

form.uploadDescription: A document that already exists, into the archive. Nothing is written here, what you upload is what gets stored. The file can come later.
form.title: Title
form.titleHint: The words somebody would search for: “Sponsorship with Axis 2026”.
form.counterpartyHint: The organisation or person the agreement is with.
form.tagsHint: Comma separated. What you will find the contract by later.
form.notesHint: For whoever finds this next. Not printed on any document.
form.fileHint: A PDF, or a photo of a signed piece of paper. Max {max} MB.
form.sectionAgreementHint: What it is and who it is with.
form.sectionArchiveHint: So somebody finds the document again. Not printed on any document.
form.incomplete: A title and a counterparty are required.
form.dropzone: Drag the document here, or choose a file
form.otherKind: Is the section lending something out?
form.otherKindLink: Draw up a rental contract instead
form.fileIsSigned: The file is the signed contract
form.fileIsSignedHint: Then the contract is marked signed. Otherwise it is filed as a draft until the signed copy is uploaded.

detail.deleteContractConfirm: Delete the document and all its files? This cannot be undone.
detail.deleteSignedFileConfirm: {filename} is the signed contract. Removing it makes the contract a draft again.
detail.draftHint: Becomes signed once the signed contract is uploaded.

rental.newDescription: The app writes the contract for you: the section's gear, a period, a price and a deposit.
rental.purposeHint: What the gear will be used for. Under the terms (§ 1) it may not be used for anything else.
rental.emptyCatalogue: The catalogue is empty. Add rental items under Settings first.
rental.returnBeforePickup: The return date must be on or after the pickup date.
rental.conditionOutHint: What was noted when the gear left. The baseline if something is broken afterwards.
rental.conditionInHint: Electronics get a functional test, not just a look.
rental.checkedAtHint: When the gear was inspected. Damage reported within five working days of the return counts as the renter's.
rental.pickDatesFirst: Pick the period first and what is free will show.
rental.unavailable: More than is free over the period.
rental.incomplete: The renter and their address, a period, a purpose and equipment are required.
rental.documentPending: The contract is drawn here as you fill the form in. It is the same document that gets saved when you create it.
rental.lessorFixed: The section's details as the contract states them. They are changed in the code, not here.
rental.editDescription: The contract is redrawn when you save. It can be changed until the signed contract has been uploaded.
rental.signatureCountHint: How many will sign for the renter. The contract gets that many signature lines, each with room for the name written out.

items.title: Rental items
items.description: The gear the section lets out, and what it costs to replace.
items.name: Name
items.replacementValueHint: The figure the liability clause points at if it does not come back.
items.emptyDescription: Add what the section lets out, so a rental contract can pick from the list.
items.inUse: Used in {count, plural, one {1 contract} other {# contracts}}
items.pickDatesFirst: Pick the dates to see what is free
items.editSafe: Changes here do not reach contracts already drawn. A rental line copies the description and the amounts at the moment it is written.

blocker.name: The item needs a name.
blocker.replacementValue: Give a replacement value. It is the figure the liability clause points at.
blocker.quantity: The quantity must be at least 1.

counterparties.title: Counterparties
counterparties.description: Organisations and people the section has agreed with before, so a new contract can pick one instead of retyping their details.
counterparties.name: Name
counterparties.orgNoHint: Or a personal number. Free text either way.
counterparties.notesHint: Anything worth knowing before the next contract with them.
counterparties.emptyDescription: Add an organisation or person the section deals with, so a contract can pick it from the list.
counterparties.inUse: Used in {count, plural, one {1 contract} other {# contracts}}
counterparties.editSafe: Changes here do not reach contracts already drawn. A contract copies the details when the counterparty is picked.
